channel.title: The Planning Desk
channel.description: Supply chain planning and design news with a focus on the Nordics and the DACH region: a quick briefing every weekday morning, a book worth your time every Saturday and a fifteen-minute week in review every Sunday. Disruptions, trade and macro signals, planning technology and AI, real company use cases, the events worth your time and the books behind good planning. The Planning Desk is produced with AI. AI agents gather and summarise news and books from public sources, and the hosts' voices are synthetic.

item.title: Wed 28 Oct: Audi Builds Past the Tariff
item.description:
Audi commits four billion dollars to its first US plant in Georgia, citing the 15% EU car tariff. Also: a Horváth study on slow AI adoption in logistics, Kroger's shelf data and RFID, Dahl's new Enköping warehouse, and Allianz Trade's German insolvency forecast.

item.title: Tue 27 Oct: Who Signs Off on AI
item.description:
AI is mainstream in German logistics, according to a BVL study shared at Supply Chain CX in Berlin, and the company stays liable when an agent errs. Plus Oracle's new replanning agents, ocean spot rates rising as Suez reopens, Bring's Swedish peak-season capacity and a security flaw in warehouse barcode scanners.

Sources:

item.title: Mon 26 Oct: Bring's New Border Hub
item.description:
A quiet weekend in planning news. Bring opens Logistikcenter Moss, its largest parcel terminal by sorting capacity, as Swedish e-commerce flows into Norway keep growing. Plus the dates to watch: the EU small-parcel fee, Gartner's planning summit and Logistik & Transport in Gothenburg.

item.title: Week 43: Low Water, Hot Chips, Working Agents
item.description:
Record-low water on the Rhine and rail works squeeze freight into Germany and Switzerland, while carriers return to Suez and Hormuz stays almost shut. Cisco puts a number on its demand-planning agent, AI data centres compete for chips and air cargo, and DSV, Kuehne+Nagel and Meds report on network changes. Plus SAP and Pigment, EU trade defences against China, and the events ahead.
